$comment: This file is itself inside the protected set — see protectedArtefacts below — so narrowing the protected set requires the same review as changing a specification.

materialContributionPolicy.statement: An agent's contribution to a change is material if any of the following is true: (a) more than a trivial amount of the change's non-whitespace content originated from the agent; (b) the agent chose the structure, name, or interface of anything that persists past the change; (c) the change would not have been produced, or would have been substantially different, without the agent.
materialContributionPolicy.appliesTo: Every commit. A commit meeting any clause above carries the attestation trailer described in attestation below.
notMaterial: Agent used solely to look something up, with no output incorporated into the change

conventions: Values are lowercase-hyphenated slugs. Tool and Model values must be written identically by every member for the same tool or model.
Commits with no material agent contribution carry no trailer. Do not write 'Agent-Authored: false'.
No URLs in any trailer value. The attestation record must be self-contained in the commit message.

accountableHumans.note: Per-commit accountability is the commit author. Replace this with named scopes if ownership is divided.
